description: A coffee shop sells mochas and regular coffees. Each mocha requires 3 units of coffee powder and 6 units of milk. Each regular coffee requires 6 units of coffee powder and 2 units of milk. The shop has available 400 units of coffee powder and 500 units of milk. Making a mocha takes 5 minutes and making a regular coffee takes 3 minutes. Since mochas are more popular among people, the shop must make at least 3 times as many mochas as regular coffees. How many of each should they make to minimize the total production time?

CoffeePowderPerMocha.definition: Amount of coffee powder required to produce one mocha

MilkPerMocha.definition: Amount of milk required to produce one mocha

CoffeePowderPerRegularCoffee.definition: Amount of coffee powder required to produce one regular coffee

MilkPerRegularCoffee.definition: Amount of milk required to produce one regular coffee

AvailableCoffeePowder.definition: Total available units of coffee powder

TimePerMocha.definition: Time taken to produce one mocha

TimePerRegularCoffee.definition: Time taken to produce one regular coffee

MochaToRegularRatio.definition: Minimum multiple of mochas required compared to regular coffees

objective.description: "Minimize the total production time for making mochas and regular coffees"

constraints.description: 6 * (number of mochas) + 2 * (number of regular coffees) should not exceed 500 (available milk)
The number of mochas should be at least 3 times the number of regular coffees
The number of mochas and the number of regular coffees should be non-negative

RegularCoffeeQuantity.definition: Number of regular coffees to produce
